paper.title: HUI360: A 360° Egocentric Dataset and Baselines for Human-Robot Interaction Anticipation

review.question: 近一年鱼眼镜头（含全景/环视/超广角相机）在具身智能领域的应用方式、效果与局限是什么？哪些任务获益、哪些受限？

research_question: 本论文问题：如何构建并评测 in-the-wild 的人机交互预期（interaction anticipation）数据与基线——以非歧义物理交互为可自动标注的定义、以 360° ego 全景视频为传感载体、以跨环境与跨数据集协议评估泛化。综述问题映射：该文是'360° 全景相机作为具身平台 ego 传感器（数据基础设施+社交感知任务）'路线的核心证据，覆盖应用方式（全景采集+区域化自动标注管线+跨平台同质标注）、量化效果（AUC/AP/F1/前瞻/帧率/特征消融全套基线）与多层局限（物理定义收窄、跨域精度崩塌、非全景原生方法、无度量距离）。
contributions: HUI360 数据集：9 环境/20 天/3 个月 in-the-wild 采集的 360° ego 全景视频，612K 有人帧、4310 tracks、375 物理交互、1M 预处理标注（2D poses/242+面部关键点/分割掩码），原始 360° 图像按 GDPR 按需开放——Table I 中唯一 360 FoV+tracks+poses+9 场景组合。
开源自动标注管线：任意 360° equirectangular 视频上的检测（4 wrap-around 区域 YOLOv11x）、跟踪/分割（SAM2.1 移动区域）、姿态（ViTPose+Sapiens）、物理交互判定（掩码-交互区相交，移动交互区用 SAM2 跟踪+Convex Hull）+人工修正接口与专用工具。
SSUP-A 扩展：对既有移动垃圾桶 360° 数据（1.15M 帧）施加同质管线得 6M 标注（27,698 tracks/419 交互），使跨机器人平台（固定 vs 移动、服务 vs 垃圾桶）零样本迁移可评估。
形式化评估协议与基线：T_ADV/T_POS/T_CUT 采样协议 + RF/MLP/LSTM 基线在迁移（in/cross-dataset）、预测（0.33-2.0s 六档）、输入帧率（15-1Hz 四档）、特征集（D1-D7）四轴的系统结果——该任务首个跨数据集评估。

method.summary: 传感与采集：定制服务机器人（提供食物/贴纸等物品、静止放置）机顶 360° 全景相机采集 ego 视频，9 环境/68 recordings/1937 episodes（episode=检测到人前 10s 至消失后 10s），71.3h 录制提取 11.3h 有效 episodes（15fps、612K 帧）；SSUP-HRI 垃圾桶数据（NYC 公共广场、移动平台、Wizard of Oz）以同管线处理成 SSUP-A（1.15M 帧、5.5 人/帧）。自动标注管线：ERP 全景图不做全景原生推理——检测在 4 个 wrap-around 重叠固定区域（W/2×H、仅保留中心半区）上以 YOLOv11x 进行；SAM2.1-Image 初始化分割+ViTPose 过滤（有效关键点/掩码内关键点/掩码尺寸阈值）；SAM2.1-Video 在围绕目标的移动区域逐帧跟踪（无 reprompt、仅记忆库，IoU>0.7 或 95% 被包含即终止；掩码腐蚀膨胀 k=11 便于 RLE）；姿态双模型 ViTPose-B（17 COCO，256×192）与 Sapiens-0.6B-Pose-308（含 242 面部，1024×768）互补。交互判定：人掩码与交互区（机器人托盘/垃圾桶顶）相交；移动相机情形逐帧 SAM2 跟踪交互区取 Convex Hull 求交。人工策展：专用工具作废/删/拆/并 track 与修标签（15% episodes 作废）。任务形式化：观测窗 T 帧、T_ADV=T_POS=T_CUT+1 提前量、负样本 T0 取 mask 最大时刻（距离代理）、正负样本各 1 段/track；基线 RF（500 树深 5）/MLP（[32,256]）/LSTM（3 层 128 隐）以加权 BCE 训练，特征 D3=掩码面积+框位置+ViTPose 关键点，AUC 为主指标。
assumptions: 物理交互（掩码-交互区相交）是交互预期任务的可操作且可自动扩展的代理定义；凝视/犹豫/语言等前接触信号刻意排除（标注模糊性）。
mask 尺寸在无严重遮挡时是人-机距离的可靠代理（RGBD 交叉验证）；框尺寸次之。
区域裁剪（region-images）足以让常规透视图像训练的检测/分割/姿态模型在 ERP 全景图上可靠工作，无需全景原生微调。
交互区为凸形状时掩码相交判据有效（非凸外观需人工修正，如 SSUP-A 的垃圾袋变形）。
负样本以'最大 mask 时刻'对齐可缓解正负不平衡与远离机器人的明显负例偏置。

findings.finding: HUI360 填补 360° FoV×规模×策展的组合缺口：612K 帧/4310 tracks/375 交互/9 场景，合并 SSUP-A 达 1.8M 帧/32,008 tracks——Table I 中唯一 360 FoV 且有 tracks+poses 的数据集。

findings.finding: 全景 ego 数据上交互预期可行：in-dataset LSTM AUC 0.91（MLP 0.86/RF 0.81）；前瞻 1s 内 AUC≥0.89、2s 降至 0.77；跨数据集（换机器人平台）AUC 保持 0.84-0.88。
findings.scope: HUI360 Test（71 正/377 负）与双向跨数据集，D3 特征、T_ADV=15

findings.finding: 跨数据集精度崩塌：LSTM AP 0.60（HUI360 内）→0.16（零样本 SSUP-A）、F1 0.61→0.23——AUC 0.84 的迁移表象下，真实不平衡（0.03 正例）条件查准率接近不可用。

findings.finding: 部署边界：3Hz 输入 AUC 0.85 基本保持、1Hz 坍塌至 0.78；细粒度 Sapiens 308/242 面部关键点相对 ViTPose 17 无实质增益（LSTM 0.88-0.90 vs 0.91）——判别信息集中于低维几何特征。

findings.finding: 全景处理的工程范式与代价：region-images+4 wrap-around 区域让常规模型吃 ERP 全景（region 裁剪规避全景负面效应）；无度量距离以 mask 尺寸代理（RGBD 验证相关、框尺寸 less stable）；15% episodes 人工剔除保质量。

transfer_boundary: 结论可迁移范围：360° 全景相机作为静止/移动具身平台的 ego 传感器，经'4 wrap-around 区域+SAM2 移动区域+双姿态模型+掩码-交互区相交'管线可规模化产出 in-the-wild HRI 预期数据（612K+1.15M 帧），其上 LSTM 基线取得 in-dataset AUC 0.91、1s 前瞻 AUC≥0.89、3Hz 部署 0.85、跨平台 AUC 0.84-0.88；mask 尺寸可作距离代理（RGBD 验证）。不可迁移/未验证：跨域查准率（AP 0.16，阈值化部署不可用）、非物理接触类社会信号预期（定义排除）、全景原生模型收益（基线 basic、ERP 特性未利用）、度量距离与接近动力学、1Hz 以下帧率、文化与场所外推、自动标注精度（未量化）。

design_strengths: 数据集设计针对泛化痛点：9 环境多 setup 采集+两环境留出、SSUP-A 跨平台同质标注，使 in-dataset 跨环境与零样本跨数据集两级评估可行——该任务首个跨数据集评估。
交互定义可操作化且自动可扩展（物理接触+几何判据），并以 15% episodes 人工剔除+专用修正工具控制质量；伦理/GDPR 流程完整（批准决定号、撤回机制+人脸识别辅助定位）。
评估四轴（迁移/前瞻/帧率/特征）与真实部署关切一一对应，AUC 为主指标的选择理由（阈值依赖应用）明示，并以 AP/F1 暴露不平衡影响——指标自我限定诚实。
开源管线+数据+修正工具，region-images 等工程细节（Algorithm 1 形式化）完整可复现。
design_risks: 正例绝对量小（HUI360 Test 71、SSUP-A Test 154，交互仅 375/419 例），AUC/AP 的置信区间未报告，小样本下跨数据集结论稳健性未知。
基线刻意简单（RF/MLP/LSTM），无任何时空深度模型或预训练视觉基座对照——数字只定义下界而非该数据上可达水平，容易在外部引用时被误读为任务难度上限。
自动标注管线无标注质量量化（自动 vs 人工一致率、SSUP-A 修正量），标签噪声对基线数字的影响未评估。
负样本对齐以 mask 最大时刻为 T0 的启发式可能引入选择偏置（靠近者更可能被判负例的构造性关联），作者仅以'经验上可靠'带过（细节在补充材料）。
SSUP-A 以 15fps 重处理原 30fps 数据并手工滤除无效段，与 HUI360 帧率对齐但丢弃量未完整披露（脚注只给 1.15M/9.8h+12.1h）。
critical_appraisal.baseline_fairness: 三基线共享同一特征与采样协议、超参与训练细节全披露，内部公平性高；但基线族本身（RF/MLP/LSTM）远离当前时空建模水平，且无第三方方法在同一划分上可比（HRI 预期文献各用私有数据），'首个跨数据集评估'同时也是'无外部方法可对比'的信号。
critical_appraisal.metric_validity: AUC 作为主指标对不平衡数据的排序能力有效但被作者自述有局限，AP/F1 补充使真实部署差距可见（0.60→0.16）——指标组合诚实且互补；前瞻/帧率曲线的口径（仅长 tracks、T_ADV=15 与主表略异）披露清楚；mask 距离代理经 RGBD 交叉验证是少见的负样本构造有效性检验。
critical_appraisal.reproducibility: 高：数据（标注开放、原始 360 图像按需）+代码+修正工具+管线形式化（Algorithm 1/2）+超参全披露+Grid'5000 算力致谢；残余风险：原始图像 GDPR 按需流程、机构场景接入门槛、以及 SSUP-A 重处理的丢弃细节。
critical_appraisal.external_validity: 中：9 环境+2 城市跨平台提供一定外部效度，且跨数据集协议正是外部效度检验本身；但环境均为机构/广场类公共场所、机器人为静止服务型/移动垃圾桶两类、人群文化与年龄结构未报告，向家庭/医院/多文化场景与移动服务机器人的外推未检验；交互定义的物理接触口径进一步收窄可迁移行为谱。

evidence_cards.claim: 应用方式：固定服务机器人以机顶 360° 全景相机（egocentric panoptic 360° 图像）为唯一视觉传感器，在 9 个真实环境、跨 3 个月共 20 天的部署中采集 in-the-wild 人机交互预期数据集 HUI360（多天/多环境/自然发生行为），并配套开放任意 360° 等距柱面视频的自动交互标注管线与人工修正接口；原始 360° 全景图像按 GDPR 按需开放（仅限研究用途）。
evidence_cards.relation: 支持命题：360° 全景相机作为服务机器人 ego 视觉传感器用于 HRI 交互预期（embodied 社交感知任务）是鱼眼/全景镜头在具身智能的核心应用方式之一——全景 FoV 使机器人无需云台转向即可捕捉四周自发行人，支撑数据规模与多样性主张。
evidence_cards.summary: 摘要给出：最大 in-the-wild HRI 预期数据集、移动机器人多天多环境采集、任意 360° equirectangular 视频的自动标注管线、1M 预处理标注与原始 panoptic 360° ego 图像（GDPR 按需）。
evidence_cards.source_context:
we introduce HUI360, the largest dataset for
human-robot interaction anticipation in the wild and its set of
baselines. The dataset was collected from a mobile robot, in the
wild, over multiple days within a 3-month period, and in several
environments, capturing natural, spontaneous behaviors from
both passersby and users, and encompassing a diverse range of
individuals. This variety enables evaluating and improving the
generalization capabilities of interaction anticipation models.
We designed a pipeline and share code for automatic interac-
tion annotation in arbitrary 360° equirectangular videos, along
with interfaces for manual refinement. Using this pipeline, we
release the HUI360 open set of 1M pre-processed annotations,
including detailed 2D poses, facial keypoints, and segmentation
masks, obtained using state-of-the-art computer vision methods
and manually curated to ensure high-quality tracking and in-
teraction annotation. Additionally, we release the raw panoptic
360° images captured from the robot’s egocentric viewpoint (on
demand, for research purpose only in compliance with GDPR).

evidence_cards.claim: 交互的自动标注以几何判据完成：只认与平台的物理交互（拿取/放置/投掷），把交互区（HUI360 为机器人托盘、SSUP-A 为垃圾桶顶）与人分割掩码的相交作为交互判据；HUI360 相机固定故交互区在画面中位置固定、判定直接；SSUP-A 相机随垃圾桶移动且自稳定导致交互区在画面中漂移，需逐帧用 SAM2 跟踪交互区并取 Convex Hull 再求交——方法适用于任意固定或移动交互区（要求凸形状）。
evidence_cards.relation: 支持命题：360° ego 视频上规模化解译'谁在跟机器人交互'的可行判据（掩码-交互区相交），以及全景相机移动/自稳定带来的交互区漂移这一全景特有工程问题及其凸包解法——应用方式（自动标注管线）的关键机制证据。
evidence_cards.summary: Section III-C.2 定义物理交互与交互区判据，说明 HUI360（固定区）与 SSUP-A（移动区+Convex Hull）两种情形及凸形状适用条件。

evidence_cards.source_context:
We adopt a precise
definition of an interaction where we only consider physical
interaction with the platform. In practice, we define an
interaction zone (the trashcans in SSUP-A and the plate
of the robot in HUI360) and consider that someone is
interacting when their segmentation mask intersects with
this zone. Doing so is straightforward in HUI360, as the
interaction zone occupies a fix place in the camera frame,
but the mounting of the camera on the trashcans of SSUP
makes that they move and appear differently in the camera
frame; in consequence, we use a different intersection mask
for each frame obtained with SAM2 with a manual prompt of
the initial position and refined by computing its Convex Hull,
such that, when someone throws something or puts their hand
in the trashcan, we can still compute the intersection, see this
process in the Supplementary Materials (Figure 9).
Our method can then be used for any fixed or moving
interaction zone as long as it is a convex shape.

verification.rationale: page 4 逐字给出 we only consider physical interaction with the platform、an interaction zone (the trashcans in SSUP-A and the plate of the robot in HUI360)、interacting when their segmentation mask intersects with this zone、the mounting of the camera on the trashcans of SSUP makes that they move and appear differently in the camera frame、obtained with SAM2 with a manual prompt of the initial position and refined by computing its Convex Hull、any fixed or moving interaction zone as long as it is a convex shape；claim 为原文的忠实复述。

evidence_cards.source_context:
Two methods were used because they appear to be com-
plementary. Indeed, ViTPose operates reliably and robustly at
reasonable working resolutions (256×192), whereas Sapiens
works at much higher resolutions (1024×768) but provides a
very precise estimation with keypoints on the face and hands.
In our dataset 26% of the boxes have and height h < 256,
73% have h ∈ [256, 1024] and 0.4% have h > 1024 (after
×1.25 expansion as used for those methods). Meaning that
most of the persons images are downscaled for ViTPose and
upscaled for Sapiens, ultimately 73% of ViTPose and 62%
of Sapiens keypoints (64% for facial keypoints, and 55% for
the rest) are valid (i.e. with a score c > 0.5).

evidence_cards.source_context:
To push even
further the diversity of environments, we annotated the
SSUP-HRI dataset [1], which was collected in the wild
during 2 field sessions of 5 days each, one year apart, on
public squares of New York using 2 mobile trash barrels
equipped with 360 cameras and operated in a Wizard of
Oz fashion. The videos exhibit a full range of passerbys
and users all around, with individual and group interactions.
The different nature of behaviors, the shift in viewpoint, as
well as the use of a mobile recording platform make it an
interesting testbed for benchmarking the transferability of
HRI anticipation methods to drastically different domains.
We detected, tracked and annotated an average of 5.5 persons
per frame, on a total of 1.15M frames.
For practical reasons, we split the SSUP dataset in 5
minutes episodes, meaning that some tracks are interrupted
and restarted as a new one in the next episode.

evidence_cards.source_context:
To ensure the quality of the data we share, we proceeded to
manual curation using specifically designed user interfaces.
Our curation consisted in (1) flagging full episodes as invalid
for reason such as: multiple abnormal behaviors attributed to
the novelty of the robot’s presence, presence of the operator
for technical task (launching/stopping recording, maintaining
the robot), multiple and non recoverable tracking issues,
removal request in compliance with our ethics protocol and
GDPR, (2) corrections on tracking : removing, splitting or
associating tracks, (3) corrections on automatic labeling (es-
pecially in SSUP-A) : correcting false negatives (interaction
without masks intersection such as throwing or dropping
an object without direct contact) and false positives (mostly
induced by an excessive interaction zone mask when it ap-
pears as not convex because of the moving 360 camera view
point). We refer to the Supplementary Materials (Figure 10)
for examples of such issues that were flagged or corrected.
Overall 15% of episodes were flagged and not exported.

We acknowledge that the operational definition of inter-
action adopted in HUI360, based on physical contact with
the platform, captures only a subset of the rich spectrum of
human-robot interaction behaviors. In particular, it does not
explicitly model pre-contact social signals such as gaze, hes-
itation, verbal engagement, or approach-and-stop behaviors,
which may also convey interaction intent.
This design choice reflects a trade-off between scalability
and semantic richness. While objective and automatically
measurable criteria enable large-scale and reproducible anno-
tation, they also limit the range of interactions captured. We
thus consider HUI360 as a foundation rather than a complete
definition, and hope that the release of both the raw 360° data
and the annotation pipeline will support future extensions
toward more nuanced and socially grounded interaction
labels.

evidence_cards.claim: 基线与全景表示均未充分开发：作者自述当前基线 architecturally basic（RF/MLP/LSTM），把'利用 equirectangular 图像的特有性质'、更丰富的时空建模与社交/群体动态列为未来方向——即全景输入目前只被当普通特征源处理，其角坐标/环绕几何尚未转化为模型归纳偏置，全景 ego 数据的独特价值未被基线兑现。
evidence_cards.relation: 限制命题：360° 数据在手而全景原生方法缺席——'应用方式'仍停留在数据采集与常规管线，未出现针对 ERP 几何的模型设计；综述应把该文定位为数据基础设施证据而非全景感知方法证据。
evidence_cards.summary: 结论段：baselines architecturally basic；leveraging the specific characteristics of equirectangular imagery 列为 open direction。

open promising directions whether it is exploring richer
temporal and spatial modeling, leveraging the specific char-
acteristics of equirectangular imagery, or incorporating social
and group dynamics. In this sense, HUI360 represents not
only a significant step toward practical and generalizable
human-robot interaction anticipation, but also an important
resource for future research in socially aware robotics and
anticipatory perception.
